momentumSections.body: The recognition band, deliberately ordered LAST by an editor — and still the first thing on the page, because it is the hero now.

description: What the Order field can and cannot do now. This seed seats the recognition band LAST — order 4, behind the narrative, the track record and the pillars — and the frame shows it opening the page anyway, because the recomposition pulled it out of the reorderable flow and made it the hero. That is the whole point of the frame: the proof is in the disagreement between the seed and the picture, not in the pixels alone. Before this change the same seed would have buried the band below three sections. The contract it demonstrates is the one the hero and the closing ask already had, and it exists for the stated reason: a page whose hero can be dragged to the bottom is a page an editor can break. Kicker and Heading still drive the band, so the copy stays editable — only the position is fixed, and `momentumSections/donors.md` says so in the editor's own words. Nineteen supporters, an anonymous one among them, so the band is carrying real weight while it holds its place. NOTE: the scenario's NAME still reads 'Moved To The Top' from when an Order edit is what put it there; the slug is load-bearing elsewhere, so the name outlived the behaviour it was named for.
